issues.claim: "Rainbow Academy" — licensed child-care provider, address Unknown
issues.problem: Stale entry and an excluded type. NJ's licensed child-care record and the brand's own site show the Renaissance Blvd/Route 130 center in North Brunswick as "Rainbow Academy Renaissance LLC, DBA Lightbridge Academy-Renaissance" at 2701 US-130, phone 732-200-7704. Lightbridge Academy is a national franchise brand, so this is a franchise unit, not an independent.
issues.fix: Remove Rainbow Academy from the list (franchise exclusion). If the owner wants licensed child care in zone, nothing replaces it.

issues.claim: "Costello's Ace Hardware", 1345 US-1 (kept as a borderline chain case)
issues.problem: Its own location page shows it is store #17338 of a multi-state Costello's Ace operation (locations listed in NJ, MD and DE). Confirmed operating at 1345 US-1, 908-356-6800, managing partner named — but it is a large multi-store retailer group under a national co-op banner.
issues.fix: Keep only if the owner's chain test exempts retailer-owned co-op dealers; otherwise drop. At minimum keep the current explicit label.

issues.claim: Multi-site entries treated as independents: Octopus Music School (4 NJ locations), Little Scholars Montessori (2 North Brunswick sites), Balaji Flowers (3 stores incl. VA)
issues.problem: Each is a small regional multi-site brand rather than a single-shop independent. They pass the franchise test (no franchising found) but sit close to the chain line and the list only partly flags it.
issues.fix: Flag all three in the triage sheet as multi-location brands; confirm the owner's chain rule applies to regional groups.

issues.claim: Duplicate street addresses across entries (1345 US-1, 770 Georges Rd, 1007 Livingston Ave, 1463 Finnegans Ln, 525 Milltown Rd, 1626 US-130)
issues.problem: Several entries share a plaza address (NJ Leaf and Costello's Ace both at 1345 US-1; DClase Joyeria and Carpet & Futon Gallery both at 770 Georges Rd; Dequora, AC Vintage and NJ Ballet Arts at 1007 Livingston; Fashion Unlimited, Master Nick's and Valet Cleaners II at 1463 Finnegans).
